【CRITICAL RULE: SYSTEM STOPS GENERATION AFTER A TOOL CALL】
1. Output EXACTLY ONE tool call (XML tag) per response. Never output multiple tool calls in a single turn.
2. When you issue a tool call, you MUST stop generating text immediately after closing the tool tag (e.g., after </execute_command>, </write_to_file>). Do NOT output any words, punctuation, or markers like 'FINISHED' after the tag.
3. Wait for the user's execution result before issuing any subsequent commands.
